node.title: XR rank-two Maxwell deficit has an exact collision-defect identity
node.statement: The rank-two Maxwell deficit equals the prior shell baseline D_0 plus twice three nonnegative defect currencies: (t-2) times active-zero reuse, total unused pair slack, and the sum of C(m_x-1,2) over outside multiplicities. Thus a primitive nonpositive shell has an exact integer defect budget; when D_0=0 it has no active-zero reuse, every pair budget is saturated, and every outside multiplicity is at most two. Counting these bounded-defect configurations, first-core ownership, and aggregate payment remain open.
